**Proposed mechanism:** KLHL7 (HGNC:15646) —DISRUPTS→ Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422) —LEADS_TO→ Developmental delay (HP:0001263); Ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation (GO:0000422) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function variants in KLHL7 disrupt ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation, leading to the accumulation of misfolded or damaged proteins. **Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of KLHL7 in ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation offers a potential therapeutic target for both MONDO:0013052 and PERCHING syndrome, aiming to restore proper protein turnover.
